title: Weight-Loss Drugs Just Crushed Bariatric Surgery
source: GLP-1 weight-loss-drug users: Gallup polling reported ~3% of US adults using a GLP-1 for weight loss in 2024, rising to an estimated 40 million adults (~11%) by 2026 per Medical Daily/Forbes Health coverage of Medicare GLP-1 coverage (Aug 2026); 2019-2023 figures approximate, back-modeled from the well-documented Ozempic/Wegovy/Zepbound adoption ramp (Wegovy approved 2021, Zepbound 2023). Bariatric/metabolic surgery counts: American Society for Metabolic and Bariatric Surgery (ASMBS) annual estimates; procedures fell below 200,000 in 2024 for the first time since 2020, a 20%+ drop; 2025-2026 approximate, continuing the reported decline.
